title: Forward Cargo Door Surround Lower Corners — Detailed Visual and Eddy Current Inspection

issue.reason: Original issue of the forward cargo door surround lower corner inspection task.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Inspection of the four lower corner fittings of the CIRRANE-11 forward cargo door cut-out, combining a detailed visual examination with an eddy current sweep of the aluminium corner radius and the first fastener row.

sections.purpose: This task gives the inspection of the lower corner fittings and the cut-out corner radius of the forward cargo door on the CIRRANE-11, and the limits that decide whether an indication is acceptable.
sections.job_setup_note: The cargo door must be in the maintenance position and the sill panel and the local lining panels must be removed. The eddy current equipment must be calibrated on the aluminium reference standard at the work position and re-checked every two hours. The surface must be clean and dry before the sweep starts, and the door must not be operated while an inspector is inside the surround.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE CARGO DOOR IS SAFE AGAINST INADVERTENT OPERATION BEFORE ANY PERSON WORKS INSIDE THE DOOR SURROUND. 2. Remove the sill panel and the lining panels local to the cut-out. 3. Clean the four corner areas with the approved cleaning solvent. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of each corner gusset D5321130372071 and of the adjacent intercostal D5321133887188. 5. Examine the stringer run-out D5321132983318 for cracking at the lower end. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT REMOVE THE PROTECTIVE TREATMENT TO IMPROVE ACCESS. LOCAL REMOVAL NEEDS A SEPARATE RESTORATION. 7. Calibrate the eddy current equipment on the reference standard at 2 MHz. 8. Do the eddy current sweep of the corner radius over the full arc and of the first fastener row on each side of it. 9. Record every indication with its corner, its position on the arc and its amplitude, and compare the amplitude with the single reference figure given in the limits table. 10. Make sure that an indication above the reference amplitude is reported to the engineering organisation before the aircraft is released. 11. Install the lining and sill panels and do the cargo door operational test.
sections.close_out: Make sure that no tool or loose object is left in the door surround. Install the lining panels and the sill panel. Do the cargo door operational test and the door warning system test. Record the inspection result and the calibration checks in the aircraft technical record.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the cargo door is safe against inadvertent operation.
Put the warning notices at the door control panel.
Do not operate the door while a person is inside the surround.

title: Forward Cargo Door Surround Lower Corners — Detailed Visual and Eddy Current Inspection

issue.reason: Task given pre modification and post modification columns, with a titanium reference block and its own probe frequency and acceptance amplitude.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: Inspection of the four lower corner fittings of the CIRRANE-11 forward cargo door cut-out, combining a detailed visual examination with an eddy current sweep of the corner radius and the first fastener row.

sections.purpose: This task gives the inspection of the lower corner fittings and the cut-out corner radius of the forward cargo door on the CIRRANE-11, and the limits that decide whether an indication is acceptable.
sections.job_setup_note: The cargo door must be in the maintenance position and the sill panel and the local lining panels must be removed. Establish the corner fitting material before the equipment is set up: the aluminium fitting is examined at 2 MHz against the aluminium reference block and the titanium fitting at 500 kHz against its own block, and neither block may be used for the other material. The equipment must be calibrated at the work position and re-checked every two hours. The surface must be clean and dry before the sweep starts, and the door must not be operated while an inspector is inside the surround.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: MAKE SURE THAT THE CARGO DOOR IS SAFE AGAINST INADVERTENT OPERATION BEFORE ANY PERSON WORKS INSIDE THE DOOR SURROUND. 2. Remove the sill panel and the lining panels local to the cut-out. 3. Establish the fitted corner standard from the aircraft technical record and select the pre modification or the post modification column of the limits table accordingly. 4. Clean the four corner areas with the approved cleaning solvent. 5. Do a detailed visual inspection of each corner gusset D5321130372071 and of the adjacent intercostal D5321133887188. 6. Examine the stringer run-out D5321132983318 for cracking at the lower end. 7. CAUTION: DO NOT REMOVE THE PROTECTIVE TREATMENT TO IMPROVE ACCESS. LOCAL REMOVAL NEEDS A SEPARATE RESTORATION. 8. Calibrate the eddy current equipment on the reference block for the fitted material, at 2 MHz for aluminium and at 500 kHz for titanium. 9. Do the eddy current sweep of the corner radius over the full arc and of the first fastener row on each side of it. 10. Record every indication with its corner, its position on the arc and its amplitude, and read the acceptance figure from the column selected at step 3; the titanium column is not a scaled copy of the aluminium one and the two must not be interpolated between. 11. Make sure that an indication above the acceptance amplitude is reported to the engineering organisation before the aircraft is released. 12. Install the lining and sill panels and do the cargo door operational test.
sections.close_out: Make sure that no tool or loose object is left in the door surround. Install the lining panels and the sill panel. Do the cargo door operational test and the door warning system test. Record the inspection result and the calibration checks in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: CIRRANE-11 aircraft only. On aircraft post the titanium corner fitting standard this task is required only after a reported impact.

safety_precautions: Make sure that the cargo door is safe against inadvertent operation.
Put the warning notices at the door control panel.
Do not operate the door while a person is inside the surround.
